name: procedural-audio-orb
description: 带物理形变与程序化音频的减压球
interaction: A soft glowing orb reacts to your grip with real-time physics-based deformation — squish, stretch, and release. Each deformation drives procedural audio synthesis, mapping pressure and velocity to pitch, timbre, and resonance. The result is a tactile-sonic stress ball where every squeeze becomes a unique generative soundscape.
